'''Football''' was a ball sport, and one of several types which was regularly practiced in the [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Sports in the Star Wars Galaxy">{{SW|url=news/take-me-out-to-the-ballgame-sports-in-the-star-wars-galaxy-part-2|series=Sports in the Star Wars Galaxy|text=Part 2: Take Me Out to the Ball Game|nolive=1}}</ref>

==History==
A newsfeed during the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]] referred to football as the most important sport in an article about the second-most important.<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth" />
